audience: Indian merchants and freelancers who collect payments with Instamojo payment links

useCases.title: Find payment requests that are still pending
useCases.text: The AI lists payment requests (payment links) with purpose, amount in INR, buyer and status (Pending, Sent, Failed, Completed). You see which links are unpaid.

useCases.title: See the payments made on a payment request
useCases.text: The AI opens a payment request and then each payment with status, amount, fees, buyer, instrument such as UPI or card, and failure reason.

useCases.title: List and check refunds
useCases.text: The AI lists refunds with payment id, status, reason type, refund and total amount and date, and opens one by its case id.

useCases.title: Create a payment link for an amount
useCases.text: The AI creates a payment request for an amount in INR and returns the short and long URL to share. The buyer is emailed or texted only if you ask.

useCases.title: Turn a payment link off or on, or refund a payment
useCases.text: The AI disables a payment link so it stops accepting payments, or enables it again, or refunds a payment in full or in part. Only one refund is allowed per payment.
